abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Scheduler is allowed.

data_description.workday_entity: The binary sensor used by the workday and weekend day options. Upstream Scheduler hard-codes binary_sensor.workday_sensor; point this at your own sensor if it lives elsewhere. Schedules plan ahead using the sensor's 'workdays' attribute when it has one.
data_description.notify_on_failure: Raise a persistent notification when a schedule's action cannot run. Failures are always logged and published as a scheduler_action_failed event.
